heroHeadline: BOJ Lifts Rate to 1.25% on a 7-2 Vote as Takaichi Reshuffles Cabinet With Key Ministers Retained
heroSubtitle: The Bank of Japan raised its policy rate to a 31-year high of 1.25% on September 18, a day after PM Takaichi's first reshuffle kept the finance, foreign and defense ministers and brought a coalition partner into Cabinet ahead of an October extraordinary Diet session
footerNote: Data sourced from the National Archives of Japan, National Diet Library, UNESCO World Heritage records, IAEA, World Bank, IMF, Bank of Japan, Ministry of Defense, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and major academic institutions.
